items.title: Introducing AWS Billing Conductor and AWS Billing Transfer views as source views for custom billing views
items.summary: We are excited to announce that AWS Billing Conductor billing group views and AWS Billing Transfer views are now supported as source views for custom billing views. If you resell AWS services to end customers, or you use billing groups to model business units, you can now combine the views AWS already maintains for you […]
